run_parse_link_map: run the script with a link map file path to print library and symbol sizes
parse_link_map_function: parse an Xcode link map file and return core, ObjC, BoringSSL, Protobuf, and total symbol sizes
analyze_library_sizes: analyze an iOS link map file to calculate sizes for gRPC-Core, ObjC, BoringSSL, and Protobuf libraries
extract_symbol_stats: extract symbol statistics from an Xcode link map file by parsing object files, sections, and symbols
categorize_symbols_by_library: categorize symbols by library name and aggregate their sizes for BoringSSL, gRPC-Core, ObjC, and Protobuf
